summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 306,299 of its own ordinary shares (5 pence each) on 17 April 2026, conducted via JP Morgan Securities plc under a share buyback arrangement announced 6 January 2026. Shares were bought on the London Stock Exchange at an average price of 11.0579 GBP per share (low 10.9800, high 11.2650). The company intends to cancel the repurchased shares. Post-transaction, shares outstanding are 2,523,718,498. This is an issuer tender under UK and Hong Kong rules, returning capital to shareholders. Watch for continued buybacks and impact on EPS and share count.
